stops.name: IJmuiden an Zee
stops.detail: In the north near IJmuiden an Zee, a district of Velsen, numerous bunkers for the Atlantic Wall were built during the Second World War by the Organisation Todt on behalf of the German Wehrmacht.

stops.name: Heerenduinbunker
stops.detail: The ruins, such as the Heerenduin bunkers, are now partially national monuments, can be entered, and there is a bunker museum in IJmuiden.

stops.name: Ehrenfriedhof Bloemendaal
stops.detail: 372 victims were reburied in the newly established Bloemendaal Cemetery of Honour, and memorial stones at the execution sites commemorate the deeds.
